title: Age of Empires IV
provenance: himbeles confirmed gameplay on the released x64-crossover26.3-aoe4-r1 engine on 2026-11-15. A separate launch check reached the main menu with Steam build 26559323 on an Apple M2 Max with macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, the same engine and D3DMetal.
notes: An opt-in recipe offers the AoE IV engine on Highball builds that include it. Apply the fix on the game's page, then launch with Play in Highball. If the game shows a graphics driver warning at startup, click OK to continue.
